name: ELEV8MI Tarot
description: 78-card ELEV8MI deck: recolored public-domain 1909-1910 Rider-Waite-Smith art (Pamela Colman Smith) in a custom ELEV8MI frame.
fields_note: cards[] is in the same order as window.Elev8TarotDeck (tarot-deck.js); index matches its index field and id matches Elev8Deck.fileName(card). number: majors 0-21, minors 1-14 (1 ace ... 10 ten, 11 page, 12 knight, 13 queen, 14 king). Meanings are copied from tarot-deck.js so the site text and manifest agree.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: Beginnings, trust, a leap taken before the map is finished.
cards.reversed: Hesitation, recklessness, or a leap you are not ready to name.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: Will, skill, and the tools already in your hands.
cards.reversed: Scattered focus, unused talent, or talk without the working.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: Hidden knowledge, intuition, what is known but not yet said.
cards.reversed: Ignored instinct, secrets, or noise covering a quiet truth.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: Abundance, care, creative growth, the body as oracle.
cards.reversed: Depletion, overgiving, or a harvest delayed.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Structure, boundaries, a throne you are ready to occupy.
cards.reversed: Rigidity, control, or authority that no longer fits.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: Tradition, a teacher, a practice with a lineage.
cards.reversed: Blind obedience, or a ritual that has gone hollow.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: A true choice, alignment, union of values.
cards.reversed: Misalignment, temptation, a choice avoided.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Will in motion, a victory that asks for a steady hand.
cards.reversed: Force without direction, or a stalled campaign.

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: Quiet courage, patience with the animal self.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt, force used where softness would open the door.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Solitude, a lantern, the answer found by walking alone.
cards.reversed: Isolation, withdrawal past the point of wisdom.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: A turn in the cycle. Fate moves; so can you.
cards.reversed: Resistance to change, or luck you are not ready to meet.

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: Cause and consequence, a clean accounting.
cards.reversed: Avoided truth, imbalance, a verdict still unpaid.

cards.name: The Hanged One
cards.upright: Surrender, a new angle, wisdom bought by waiting.
cards.reversed: Stalling, martyrdom, a pause that has become a trap.

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: An ending that clears the path. Compost, not catastrophe.
cards.reversed: Clinging, fear of the necessary close.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: Blend, pace, the middle way that still moves.
cards.reversed: Excess, impatience, ingredients that will not mix yet.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: Bond, appetite, a chain you can see and therefore loosen.
cards.reversed: Denial of the pattern, or a bargain you keep renewing.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: Sudden truth. The false structure comes down.
cards.reversed: Delayed collapse, or rebuilding on the same cracked stone.

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: Hope after the storm, a clear night, healing in public view.
cards.reversed: Dim faith, disconnection from the wish you still hold.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: Dreams, fog, the path that is real but not yet lit.
cards.reversed: Anxiety, illusion, a fear wearing the mask of instinct.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Vitality, clarity, a yes the room can feel.
cards.reversed: Dimmed joy, burnout, success you will not let yourself have.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.upright: A calling, a reckoning, the self rising to answer.
cards.reversed: Self-judgment, a summons ignored.

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: Completion, arrival, the dance at the end of a cycle.
cards.reversed: Loose ends, a finish line you keep moving.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.upright: A spark of inspiration invites a creative beginning.
cards.reversed: A promising idea needs time, energy or a clearer purpose.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.upright: Consider your wider possibilities before choosing a direction.
cards.reversed: Fear of change may be keeping your plans too small.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.upright: Your first efforts open the way to expansion and new horizons.
cards.reversed: Delays invite you to revisit expectations and practical support.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.upright: Celebrate stability, belonging and a milestone shared with others.
cards.reversed: An unsettled foundation or strained group dynamic needs care.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.upright: Different ambitions create friction; channel competition into learning.
cards.reversed: Step away from needless conflict, but address unresolved tension.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.upright: Progress earns recognition; receive it without losing perspective.
cards.reversed: Seek confidence within rather than depending on approval.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.upright: Stand by your values while choosing your battles carefully.
cards.reversed: Feeling overwhelmed may call for firmer boundaries or support.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.upright: Events gain momentum; a message or opportunity may arrive quickly.
cards.reversed: Rushing or crossed signals ask for clearer timing and communication.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.upright: Resilience carries you forward; protect your energy after a long effort.
cards.reversed: Exhaustion can make every challenge feel like a threat; rest and reassess.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.upright: Too much responsibility has become a burden; consider what you can delegate.
cards.reversed: Release obligations that are no longer yours to carry.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.upright: Curiosity and enthusiasm invite exploration of a new idea.
cards.reversed: An exciting impulse needs follow-through rather than another fresh start.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.upright: Bold action and adventurous energy can move a plan forward.
cards.reversed: Impulsiveness or inconsistent effort may undermine your direction.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.upright: Warm confidence and independence help your creativity flourish.
cards.reversed: Comparison or self-doubt may be dimming your own voice.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.upright: Lead with vision, courage and a clear sense of purpose.
cards.reversed: Impatience or domination may be crowding out collaboration.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional openness offers a new connection or creative renewal.
cards.reversed: Make space for feelings that have been held back or neglected.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.upright: Mutual respect and connection invite a balanced partnership.
cards.reversed: A relationship needs honest attention to imbalance or disconnection.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.upright: Friendship and community bring joy worth celebrating.
cards.reversed: Social strain or excess may be asking for healthier boundaries.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.upright: Pause to notice an offer you may be overlooking through disengagement.
cards.reversed: Renewed interest may help you reconnect with what matters.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.upright: Acknowledge disappointment while noticing what remains available.
cards.reversed: Healing begins as you loosen the grip of regret.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.upright: A memory, kindness or familiar connection offers perspective.
cards.reversed: The past may be limiting your ability to meet the present.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.upright: Many possibilities appear; distinguish imagination from a workable choice.
cards.reversed: Clarity grows when you narrow the options and act deliberately.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.upright: Leave behind what no longer fulfills you, even if it once did.
cards.reversed: Ask whether fear or unfinished feelings are keeping you in place.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.upright: Appreciate satisfaction and what you have already achieved.
cards.reversed: A wish fulfilled may not address the deeper need underneath it.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.upright: Shared emotional wellbeing and belonging offer a sense of harmony.
cards.reversed: Look honestly at gaps between an ideal relationship and daily reality.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.upright: A tender message or intuitive idea invites an open response.
cards.reversed: Sensitivity needs care; avoid confusing a hope with a promise.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.upright: An imaginative or heartfelt approach can deepen a connection.
cards.reversed: Romantic expectations or shifting moods may need grounding.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.upright: Compassion and intuition guide you when supported by clear boundaries.
cards.reversed: Care for your own emotional needs rather than absorbing everyone else’s.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.upright: Emotional steadiness helps you respond with both kindness and judgment.
cards.reversed: Notice where suppressed feelings or emotional control are distorting a response.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.upright: A clear insight or honest conversation cuts through confusion.
cards.reversed: Seek better information before acting on an uncertain conclusion.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.upright: A difficult decision asks you to face what has been held at a distance.
cards.reversed: Indecision may lift when you acknowledge the uncomfortable truth.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.upright: Painful truth or disappointment deserves honest recognition and care.
cards.reversed: Healing is possible as you process hurt rather than repeatedly reopening it.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.upright: Rest and mental distance are part of recovery, not a failure to act.
cards.reversed: If you are returning to activity, do so before exhaustion drives the pace.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.upright: Winning an argument may cost more than it gives; consider the aftermath.
cards.reversed: Reconciliation begins with accountability and a willingness to stop fighting.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.upright: A transition carries you toward calmer conditions, even with sadness attached.
cards.reversed: Unfinished concerns may be making it hard to move beyond an old situation.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.upright: Strategy matters; examine secrecy, avoidance and the consequences of your choices.
cards.reversed: Honesty or an admission may offer a cleaner path than concealment.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.upright: A limiting belief may be making your options seem smaller than they are.
cards.reversed: A new perspective helps you recognize freedom that was hidden by fear.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.upright: Anxiety and rumination need compassion, support and a reality check.
cards.reversed: Sharing a worry may loosen isolation and make recovery possible.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.upright: A painful ending marks a point after which recovery can begin.
cards.reversed: The worst may be passing; resist rebuilding the same harmful pattern.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.upright: Curiosity and careful observation invite questions before conclusions.
cards.reversed: Avoid reacting to rumors, incomplete facts or words used carelessly.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.upright: Direct action and intellectual conviction can cut through delay.
cards.reversed: Speed or aggression may be outrunning understanding.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.upright: Clear boundaries and honest discernment make space for a fair response.
cards.reversed: Sharp judgment may need more compassion or better context.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.upright: Use reason, integrity and responsibility to make a sound decision.
cards.reversed: Authority without fairness or openness can become rigid and harmful.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.upright: A practical opportunity invites a grounded beginning in work or resources.
cards.reversed: A promising opportunity needs preparation, timing or a realistic plan.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.upright: Balance changing demands with flexibility and clear priorities.
cards.reversed: Too many moving parts may require simplifying your commitments.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.upright: Skilled collaboration and learning improve what you are building.
cards.reversed: Clarify roles and respect the expertise needed for shared work.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.upright: Security matters, but notice where holding tightly limits generosity or growth.
cards.reversed: Consider whether to loosen control or rebuild a sustainable boundary.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.upright: Difficulty or exclusion calls for support; you do not have to face it alone.
cards.reversed: Help, recovery or a renewed sense of belonging may become available.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.upright: Giving and receiving work best with fairness and mutual dignity.
cards.reversed: Look for unequal power, hidden obligations or one-sided generosity.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.upright: Patient investment asks you to evaluate progress before the next step.
cards.reversed: Reconsider where continued effort is producing too little return.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Practice, attention and steady work develop meaningful skill.
cards.reversed: Perfectionism or distracted work may be replacing genuine learning.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.upright: Enjoy the independence and wellbeing built through your own efforts.
cards.reversed: Revisit what security means beyond appearances or constant achievement.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.upright: Long-term stability grows through shared resources, care and continuity.
cards.reversed: A family or financial structure may need a more sustainable agreement.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.upright: A practical goal invites study, planning and the first consistent step.
cards.reversed: An ambition needs a workable routine rather than indefinite preparation.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.upright: Patient and reliable effort moves you forward, one useful step at a time.
cards.reversed: Habit or stubbornness may be keeping a plan from adapting.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.upright: Practical care and resourcefulness nurture both wellbeing and daily life.
cards.reversed: Restore balance between caring for others and caring for yourself.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.upright: Responsible stewardship and experience support lasting stability.
cards.reversed: Status or control may be crowding out generosity and sound priorities.
